title: The mall world I know is hectic and fast paced
content: I see so many posts of people exploring and taking in what they see in the mall world. It's not like that to me. I can only identify a few places in the mall I go to. Usually when I'm in the mall I'm looking for someone, something, or I'm being chased. I have been to a bargain store, looking similar inside to a Walmart. I've been to a few small clothing boutiques. One place I've been to multiple times is a large Arts and Crafts store. My time in these places is very quick and limited. I'm usually rushing and asking people for help frantically. I'm running up and down the stairs and through the corridors in circles. Whenever I get to a new area and inquire for the person or thing I'm looking for I am told that I just missed them/it and if I hurry I might catch them. Or, if I'm being chased I hide and watch the figure pass before sneaking away and running more.
